free_tier.stated: $0 per month plus usage, with $10 of starter credits for 60 days covering about 43 hours of Standard environments; 1 engineer, 3 projects, 4 concurrent vCPUs (2 Standard environments).
free_tier.notes: The $10 starter credit is granted to each person's first organization and expires in 60 days. A card can be added anytime to pay as you go with no subscription. Usage beyond the credit is $0.0504 per vCPU-hour, $0.0162 per GiB-hour of memory and $0.10 per GiB-month of disk; a 2-vCPU 8-GiB Standard environment is listed at $0.230 per hour. Direct LLM Gateway calls include 50,000 a month on Hobby, then $0.10 per 1,000; agent web searches include 100 a month, then $0.012 each. Agent model calls are $0 because models run on the user's own provider accounts with zero markup.

per_object_cap.stated: up to 50 MiB per file and up to 1 GiB per agent, bounded by the organization's 1 GiB file storage quota on Hobby; sites are up to 2,000 files, 25 MiB per file and 100 MiB total per site version
per_object_cap.notes: The 50 MiB figure is the per-file cap; the 1 GiB figure is the per-agent and organization total cap on Hobby.

retention.stated: inactive agents, transcripts and attached files are retained 90 days on Hobby; stopped environments and disks up to 7 days; sites 30 days; LLM Gateway request log 7 days

egress.terms: not published as a byte allowance or price: the pricing and limits pages give no outbound traffic quota or per-TB rate; an agent's web search and web fetch are tools counted per call (100 web searches a month on Hobby, then $0.012 each) and Direct LLM Gateway calls past allowance are $0.10 per 1,000

interface_detail: Kosem exposes a REST API with an API key for agents, projects and environments, an interactive shell in the browser, and Anthropic Messages and OpenAI Chat Completions compatible gateway endpoints at https://api.kosem.ai/v1/projects/{project}/llm/anthropic and https://api.kosem.ai/v1/projects/{project}/llm/openai/v1. Environments are isolated Linux machines on kosem-managed machines or on the user's own hosts.
tooling: REST API with service-account API keys, standard provider SDKs pointed at the LLM Gateway endpoints, an in-browser shell, and self-hosted runner pools. There is no rclone backend or object-storage interface; the resource is a Linux environment, not a bucket.
chaining: A coding agent runs in a microVM built from an OCI image on the user's own model-provider accounts, so it chains into a CI or development workflow by granting scoped short-lived GitHub, AWS or GCP credentials per task.

limits_note: Hobby allows 1 organization, 3 projects, 10 concurrent agents, 5 model providers, 2 access connections, 20 environments and 25 secrets. Agent model calls default to at most 1,000 per turn before pausing. Stopped environments are deleted after 2 days by default and unpaid stopped environments after a 14-day grace period. Monthly usage limits and credit auto-reload caps can stop paid usage.
binding_note: The $10 starter credit expiring in 60 days is the first constraint for a new account: it covers about 43 hours of Standard environments, which runs out before the 4 concurrent vCPU or 100 GiB disk ceilings, and paid usage stops when credits and the monthly allowance are exhausted.

identity_cost.detail: The quickstart says 'An email address. kosem signs you in with a code it emails you' and describes entering an email address, clicking Continue with email and entering an 8-digit code from the email. First sign-in creates the account; a passkey is an alternative sign-in. No phone number, ID document, institution or card is required to start; a card is optional to pay as you go. Using the platform needs an API key from a model provider such as Anthropic or OpenAI, whose own signup is separate.

reliability_note: A provider's own 429 rate limits pass through the LLM Gateway to agents; when credits run out, billed requests stop with CREDITS_EXHAUSTED and running environments stop while retaining their disks until deleted. Environments stop 5 minutes after an agent's turn by default and are deleted after 2 days stopped.

notes: Hosted coding-agent platform with an isolated Linux microVM per agent. Hobby is free at $0 a month on an email-only sign-in, bounded by $10 of 60-day starter credits, 4 concurrent vCPUs and 1 GiB of file storage. The user must bring model-provider API keys; kosem adds no token markup. Egress is not published as a byte quota or per-TB price, only as per-call web-search and gateway charges.
